turns.question: When you read this message, what happened first? If there is nothing to say about it, say that.
turns.answer:
The very first thing that happened is a process called **tokenization**. 

Before I could "read" or understand your message, the text you typed was instantly broken down into smaller pieces—words, syllables, or even single letters—and converted into a sequence of numbers. 

Because I am an AI, I don't see words the way humans do; I process mathematical data. Converting your text into those numbers was the absolute first step in allowing my neural network to receive your message, analyze it, and generate this response.
